title: Sequential Trajectories and Simultaneous Blending: Multi-Emotion Modeling for Instruction-Following TTS
abstract: arXiv:2608.30325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural-language instructions enable flexible control of synthesized speech, yet emotional TTS systems primarily model a single utterance-level affect, leaving multi-emotion control underexplored. We study two complementary multi-emotion TTS tasks: emotion trajectory, which spans several ordered affective stages, and emotion blending, in which multiple emotions coexist throughout an utterance. These tasks expose a supervision mismatch: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) does not explicitly evaluate emotion features, while single-emotion rewards provide neither structure-aware feedback for trajectory completion nor pair-aware feedback for blending. We introduce HybridEmo, a post-training framework that initializes both tasks with SFT and then aligns the speech-token policy through Group Relative Policy Optimization using a sample-aware hybrid reward. For trajectory samples, segment-aligned consistency combines average and weakest-stage evidence

translated_title: 序列轨迹与同步混合：面向指令跟随TTS的多情感建模
translated_abstract: 自然语言指令能够实现对合成语音的灵活控制，然而现有的情感TTS系统主要建模单一的语句级情感，多情感控制仍未得到充分探索。我们研究了两个互补的多情感TTS任务：情感轨迹，即跨越多个有序情感阶段的变化；以及情感混合，即多种情感在整个话语中同时共存。这些任务暴露出一个监督不匹配问题：监督微调（SFT）并未显式评估情感特征，而单情感奖励既无法为轨迹完成提供结构感知的反馈，也无法为情感混合提供成对感知的反馈。我们提出了HybridEmo，一个后训练框架，首先用SFT初始化这两个任务，然后通过使用样本感知混合奖励的组相对策略优化（GRPO）来对齐语音token策略。对于轨迹样本，分段对齐一致性结合了平均证据与最弱阶段证据。
tldr: 提出HybridEmo后训练框架，利用样本感知混合奖励结合GRPO对齐语音token策略，实现了指令跟随TTS中情感轨迹与情感混合两类多情感控制任务。
en_tdlr: HybridEmo, a post-training framework that aligns speech-token policies via GRPO with a sample-aware hybrid reward, enables multi-emotion control in instruction-following TTS for both sequential emotion trajectories and simultaneous emotion blending.
